method: imagegen redraw of complete poses; packaging only registers whole sprites

poses.prompt:
Edit the referenced walking character into ONE matching NEUTRAL IDLE sprite. This must be the same animation character, SAME face/hair, head size relative to torso, trouser length, boot shape and full cuff/shaft proportions, same camera and pixel-art rendering. Use the walking sprites as the definitive proportion reference, not a different chubbier character.
Pose: face straight toward viewer / screen down, same slightly elevated camera. Both knees relaxed, both boots planted side by side in a modest natural hip-width stance. Both toes point straight FORWARD toward screen bottom, not outward duck feet and not inward pigeon toes. Keep each boot the SAME width and shaft/cuff height as the walking forward boot; do not widen/squash boots for idle. Lower both arms naturally by his sides. Preserve the exact original blue scarf/coat, cream trim and shirt, charcoal short trousers, brown belt/fingerless gloves and brown cuffed leather boots.
Only adjust pose, maintain original character identity and outfit, no added equipment, no extra large head, no overall style change. One full-body sprite with generous transparent margin, no text, no labels, no shadows or ground.

cleanup.prompt: Remove ONLY the faint colored atmospheric glow / haze surrounding this sprite. Keep the actual character, pose, proportions, boots, face, clothing and pixel outlines unchanged. Everything outside the character silhouette must be fully transparent, with no halo, aura, shadow, colored backdrop or blur. Preserve crisp detailed pixel art, one full-body character. This is background cleanup only.

refinement.prompt:
Correct this one sprite's LOWER LEG AND BOOT POSE to an ordinary short WALKING stride. Preserve the SAME character face, hair, costume, arm swing, upper body, pixel art style and full-body framing. Transparent background, one full character.
The current forward boot is an exaggerated giant kick toward the camera. Replace that with a relaxed late-swing walking foot. The forward boot must have the SAME physical width, shaft, cuff, sole thickness and length as the other boot and the neutral boot reference. No oversized near-camera boot. Its sole faces mostly DOWN toward the ground, only a tiny thin heel/sole edge visible, toe just gently lifted 5 degrees. Do NOT present a broad sole directly at the viewer. Modest front-back foot separation, not a high knee marching kick. Both toes point straight forward toward screen bottom, no outward duck foot angle. Keep dark trousers covering the knees with the same length; remove any accidental bare-knee patch. Preserve full boot cuffs and normal boot volume, do not shrink to ankle shoes.
The advancing boot to correct is on SCREEN RIGHT. The opposite boot is the trailing/support foot.
